_comment: Ports listed by Mixtape in addition to the MiyooMini-Ports catalog (same fields, plus an optional inline 'recipe' with the fields described in assets/recipes.json). If MiyooMini-Ports adds the same project, its entry wins.

ports.name: Panel Attack
ports.notes: Unofficial, modified port of Panel Attack (the Tetris Attack / Puzzle League clone by the Panel Attack team, panelattack.com), not supported by them: report bugs to the port's GitHub, not to the Panel Attack team. Installs to Games > Ports (needs OnionOS's Ports system). Online play is off for now.

ports.name: MiniAmp
ports.notes: Classic-skin music player: MP3/FLAC/OGG/WAV, .wsz skins with a skin browser, 10-band EQ, visualizers. Music in games: keep listening in the menu, games and apps (SELECT+L/R skip). Add skins to MiniAmp/skins.

ports.name: Rewind
ports.notes: New movies on streaming with Rotten Tomatoes, IMDb and Metacritic scores, cast, ratings and trailers (QR to your phone). Sort and filter, and send movies to Radarr. Needs free TMDB and OMDb API keys in App/Rewind/data/config.json; it shows QR codes for both on first launch.

ports.name: Cablebox
ports.notes: TV guide in an 80s cable-box style: browse shows by channel (new, this week, popular, each streaming service, each genre) or search by name, with IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic scores, cast and trailers (QR to your phone). Order shows into Sonarr: new episodes, everything, or chosen seasons or episodes. Needs free TMDB and OMDb keys (uses Rewind's if installed).

ports.name: Carrier
ports.notes: qBittorrent remote with a retro modem look: watch progress and speeds, filter and sort torrents, stop, start, force start, recheck, set categories and file priorities, toggle slow mode, and remove torrents with or without their files. Needs your qBittorrent Web UI address (and login) in App/Carrier/data/config.json.

ports.name: Flashback
ports.notes: Anki flashcards: study shared AnkiWeb decks (.apkg) with spaced repetition, browse or shuffle them. Cloze, image occlusion, pictures, readable maths and Japanese/Chinese/Korean. Download decks on a computer from ankiweb.net/shared/decks and copy them to the Anki folder on your SD card.

ports.name: Mr. Rescue
ports.notes: Unofficial port of Mr. Rescue, the arcade firefighting game by Tangram Games: fight fires and throw people out of windows to safety. Report bugs to the port's GitHub, not to Tangram Games. Installs to Games > Ports (needs OnionOS's Ports system). B jump, A grab/throw, Y shoot.

ports.name: Spelunky Classic
ports.notes: Unofficial mod: dbeef's Spelunky-PSP remake of Derek Yu's Spelunky Classic (c) 2008-2009 Derek Yu and Mossmouth, LLC, running at full speed with sound. Not made or supported by Mossmouth or dbeef: report bugs to the port's GitHub. Free, not for sale. Installs to Games > Ports.

ports.name: Hexen II
ports.notes: uHexen2 (Hammer of Thyrion) port with a dual-core software renderer: 640x480 at 50-60 FPS, no overclock. Needs the GOG version: copy everything in its data1 folder into Roms/PORTS/Games/Hexen2/data1/, plus its music folder there for the soundtrack (optional). Original game only, no Portal of Praevus or multiplayer.

ports.name: SkiFree
ports.notes: Unofficial port of Chris Pirih's 1991 Windows classic, from the SkiFree decompilation. Ready to run, nothing else to download. Smooth 60 FPS at the original game speed, high scores with your name. Menu+Start toggles the original 25 FPS, Menu+Select shows high scores.
